payload.core_mechanism_summary: Linear DP iterating the string, counting interpretations by either keeping 'u'/'n' or collapsing consecutive pairs into 'w'/'m', using recurrence dp[i]=dp[i-1]+dp[i-2] on double letters.
payload.rationale: The solution defines a 1D DP array indexed by string position, with transitions depending only on previous states (dp[x-1], dp[x-2]), fitting the dp_1d_state subtype precisely.
